title: Halo CE enemies (HDE version)
load: HDE (Local_DEV) -> HaloCE_HDE_Bundle.pk3 (Covenant + Digsite + voices + API + Core code; nothing else).   Flood / Sentinels / Marines: HDE -> HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV.pk3 -> HaloCE_Core.pk3 -> faction packs, or HDE -> HaloCE_Merged.pk3 for everything. Never load the bundle together with HaloCE_Core or HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV.

bundle_folder.name: HaloCE_HDE_Bundle
header: // Halo CE enemies, HDE bundle: Covenant (Grunts, Jackals, Elites, Hunters), the Digsite add-on (Drinol + Cyberdemon
// boss, Slug Man, carbine / pulse-carbine Elites, Blind Wolf, Thorn Beast, Engineer, Drones, Brutes), the enemy
// dialogue, the enemy API (ZScript/BaseAI/enemies_base.zsc, replaces HDE's file of that path) and the Core code.
// Load after HaloDoom Evolved (Local_DEV). Don't load HaloCE_Core / HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV with it.
